puff 2.3 (21 Jan 2013), Mark Adler's small inflate (zlib licence: see the notice
at the top of puff.c and puff.h), from zlib 1.3.1's contrib/puff
(zlib-1.3.1.tar.gz, SHA-256 9a93b2b7dfdac77ceba5a558a580e74667dd6fede4585b91eefb60f03b72df23),
unmodified. SUBstation uses it to read gzip-compressed Ableton Live Sets
(app/src/io/LiveSet.cpp).
